meta.baseline: fa1de7c (case library batch 4) + working tree with P0-1/P0-2 landed mid-task
meta.task: Batch 2 degraded IR construction (remaining six cases) — M2 full-coverage L1/L2 prerequisite. Conversion rules X-3 per testdata/spec-audit-report.json, with rule upgrades from capability changes landed during this batch.

conversion_rule_status.rule_2_targetElementId: UPGRADED AND USED — round4 landed element-level effect targeting: contract ir.go:96 (Effect.TargetElementID), write-time validation (dangling ref = E_VIDEO_IR_INVALID), builder element-scoped highlight/pulse/shake/fade + counter positioned onto the target bbox. All 15 effects across the six IRs carry element targets where the doc specifies one; all pass Validate's reference check.
conversion_rule_status.rule_4_startFrame_endFrame: LANDED MID-TASK AND ADOPTED — the batch started with ir.go clean at fa1de7c (no window fields; windows deleted per the original rule); mid-task a parallel agent landed P0-1: Element.StartFrame/EndFrame (pointer-typed, global-timeline frame clock, validated 0 ≤ start ≤ end ≤ DurationFrames, half-open [start, end) visibility in the builder). All six IRs were UPGRADED in place to carry the case docs' own startFrame/endFrame values (doc storyboard/elements tables), so the docs' element lifecycles are now expressed natively instead of deleted.
conversion_rule_status.rule_7_fadeIn_fadeOut: LANDED MID-TASK, ZERO CONSUMERS IN THESE DOCS — validAnimationTypes now includes fadeIn|fadeOut (element-level opacity via autoAlpha). None of the six case docs' target-schema animation lists contain fadeIn/fadeOut animations, so no substitution (scaleIn/rotate approximation) was ever needed; the recorded P0-2 benefit is prospective (available to M2), not consumed here. Whole-clip fade beats remain unmapped — see rule_fade_effect_note.
conversion_rule_status.rule_fade_effect_note: Whole-clip 'light fade' end-beats (C02 F735, C07 F1185, C08 F585) stay unmapped: post-X-4 target-less fade is a one-way z-10000 black cover rising to (1-opacity) that never recovers on seek — using it would end each video in a permanent dim. With P0-2 landed, an element-level fadeOut on every on-screen element COULD reproduce the beat; per the fidelity-first rule these were left out of the degraded IRs (documented per case) rather than invented. C05's ef_fade_bars (element fade opacity 0.9) is the one doc fade that maps safely and is kept.
conversion_rule_status.rule_12_supplement_t12: NEW RULE DISCOVERED MID-TASK — the parallel agent also completed T-12: highlight on a TEXT-element target now colors the node's TEXT across the anchor word's [start, end] window (not the legacy 0.25s background flash). The six IRs keep the docs' targetElementId choices verbatim; frames.json records per effect which branch applies (text-coloring for text targets, background-flash for shape/image targets) and what the visible difference is (element granularity, no per-word spans).

meta.validate_gate: go test ./internal/video -run TestDegradedIRFiles_Validate → 8/8 PASS (six new + two batch-1), run twice: pre-upgrade (windows absent) and post-upgrade (windows present, exercising the new P0-1 validation path incl. DurationFrames bound). Gate extended beyond batch 1: every effect anchor and animation startAnchor must resolve reason=exact (no nearest/same_text/missing) — all six new IRs pass with zero non-exact resolutions; every targetElementId reference is checked by Validate.
meta.element_window_policy: Windows are taken VERBATIM from each case doc (storyboard frame ranges / elements table start/endFrame). Two doc-internal contradictions surfaced and were recorded rather than silently resolved: C05 el_place1 window (150-329) vs frame-table claim '片尾地点行就位' at 720; C05 ef_pulse_frame anchored at '水渠' (5.85s, before the vignette window opens at 330) — pulse fires on a hidden node, recorded as doc-side timing mismatch, kept per fidelity rule.

锚点歧义最重案：'重命名'出现 4 次，occurrence=0..3 显式区分全部锚点，ResolveAll 全部 reason=exact

cross_case_findings.finding: 能力升级红利三层叠加（round4 targetElementId → P0-1 时间窗 → T-12 词窗口着色）：六案 15 个 effect 全部保留并挂元素级目标；80 个元素窗口全部按文档原值采用；两个 text 高亮升级为词窗口着色。batch 1 报告 X-4 的头号降级（counter 堆画布左上原点）在 M2 全量清零；highlight/pulse 整屏闪现/缩放清零；'元素提前透出'风险类（C07 镜 4、C09 菜单/面板、C05 场景残留）整体消除。保留的可见差异：highlight 元素粒度（无逐词 span）、counter 96px/700 固定字形（C09 压状态栏）、image 目标无法词着色（截图位图）。

P0-1/P0-2 在本批执行中途落地（任务开始时 ir.go 在 fa1de7c 干净无窗口字段；中途并行 agent 提交窗口+fadeIn/fadeOut+T-12）。六案 IR 完成了一次原地升级：初版按'删除窗口'规则产出并通过 Validate；升级后按'采用文档窗口'产出并复跑 Validate（两条验证路径都走过：无窗口 back-compat 路径 + 有窗口 DurationFrames 边界校验路径）。P0-2 对六案零消费者（文档动画表均无 fadeIn/fadeOut 动画类型）；整片 fade 收束拍（C02 F735/C07 F1185/C08 F585）仍不可表达（target-less fade 黑遮罩单向语义 + 忠实原则下不给全元素代挂 fadeOut）。

target-less fade 的 post-X-4 语义必须进入 L1 判读口径：无目标 fade = z-10000 黑色遮罩单向升至 (1-opacity) 且 seek 不复原——文档四案'整片轻 fade'收束拍全部因此不映射。P0-2 落地后的正路是给每个在屏元素挂 fadeOut（元素级 autoAlpha），但那是对文档效果的'发明'而非转换——按内容忠实纪律，本批六案一律不加，frames.json 逐案记录'尾段静止收束'。L1/M2 若决定复现收束拍，应作为显式升级项（给全元素代挂 fadeOut）走变更而非静默加入。

词锚帧号与文档帧表的系统性漂移仍存在但影响面收窄：P0-1 后元素显隐/退场与文档帧表精确对位（硬切边界即文档帧号），漂移只剩'入场动画起播帧'（词表时间戳驱动）——普遍 0-33 帧（C03 公式 549 vs 文档 540；C05 色卡锚 549 vs 窗口 540；C07 KPI 606 vs 600；C09 菜单 366 vs 窗口 360）。'窗口先开、入场随后'成为六案统一模式；L1 帧差断言应拆两层：显隐边界按窗口帧（文档原值，零漂移）、入场动效按词锚帧（frames.json 逐案推导窗口）。

锚点歧义全量显式化 + 两处文档内部矛盾如实记录不静默修正：六案重复词（C02 AURA×2、C03 蓝色/散射/波长/红光×2-3、C05 红叶/橙红×2、C07 工程师×2、C08 满×3、C09 重命名×4）全部 occurrence 显式且 ResolveAll 后 reason=exact（non-exact 即测试失败的门槛）。C09 crossWord 锚按文档'按 wN 解析'注记转 occurrence=2；C05 两处文档矛盾（pulse 锚早于窗口、place1 窗口 vs 帧表片尾）忠实保留文档值并在 frames.json 显式标记。转换规则补充：跨词锚按文档'按 wN 解析'注记转为该词 occurrence。
elements ≤64 与动画 ≤16/元素余量健康：最大 C07 18 元素/C09 单元素 3 动画；复合键拆元素策略平均使元素数 ×1.9，即使 18 片粒子全拆也 <64。P0-1 窗口字段为指针型 omitempty，无窗口元素零成本 back-compat——六案 80 个窗口全部通过新校验路径（含 DurationFrames 边界）。
